findings.issue: Service role key in example without guard
findings.description: .env.local.example includes SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY with no code guard preventing accidental client-side use. Add a runtime check or move to separate .env.service.local file and document that it must never be imported in client-side code.

findings.issue: Missing RLS INSERT policy for user_profiles
findings.description: Users cannot create their own profile row after signup. Add policy: CREATE POLICY user_profiles_insert_own ON public.user_profiles FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);

findings.issue: signUp action doesn't create user_profiles row
findings.description: After Supabase auth.signUp succeeds, no profile row is created. Either add server-side insert in the action or use a Supabase trigger on auth.users insert.

findings.issue: Auth error messages leak Supabase internals
findings.description: signIn, signUp, resetPassword return error.message directly from Supabase, which may expose schema details like table names or constraint violations. Sanitize to user-friendly messages.

findings.issue: requireAuth redirect timing allows data fetch
findings.description: If requireAuth is called after a database query in the same Server Component, the query executes before the redirect. Document that requireAuth must be the first call, or restructure to throw instead of redirect.

findings.issue: App-to-module ESLint rule is warn, not error
findings.description: The ESLint rule blocking app/components from importing module internals is severity 'warn', which won't fail CI. Change to 'error' for consistency with ADR-002.
Queries filtering by event type will scan all unpublished events. Add index: CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_event_type ON outbox(event_type) WHERE published_at IS NULL;
Looking up a record's history (WHERE table_name = 'c_service_orders' AND record_id = '123') will use only one index. Add: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_record ON audit_log(table_name, record_id);

findings.issue: Architectural test doesn't catch .tsx or dynamic imports
findings.description: Test only scans .ts files. Add .tsx to the extension list. Dynamic imports (import()) won't be caught by the regex; document this limitation.
